doctrine: No number or status appears in README/PRD unless a committed artifact and a regeneration command exist for it. Status never exceeds what the artifact proves.

status_legend.VERIFIED: A committed artifact regenerated by the stated command proves the claim at the stated layer.
status_legend.PARTIAL: Some of the claim is proven; a named gap remains.
status_legend.NOT_REPRODUCIBLE: No on-disk artifact exists and the current environment cannot regenerate one. Must not be advertised as passing.

claims.claim: A commission above the configured 5% cap is rejected (e.g. 20%, 5.01%).
claims.mechanism: PRODUCTION CommissionPolicy.validateCommission(): BigInt compare commissionMsat > floor(sale * maxRatePPM / 1e6); emits EXCEEDS_MAX_PERCENT.
claims.expected: checks '20% commission rejected' and '5.01% commission rejected' = pass; '5% commission (boundary) accepted' = pass; summary 16/16.
claims.mutation_evidence: evidence/mutation-results.json — disabling the rate guard in the PRODUCTION source makes '20% commission rejected' FAIL; source restored byte-identical.
claims.limit: Policy-layer only. This run does not involve LND nodes.

claims.claim: A commission payee or marketplace caller outside the allowlist is rejected, and the two identities are distinct.
claims.mechanism: PRODUCTION validateCommission(): UNAUTHORIZED_PAYEE / UNAUTHORIZED_MARKETPLACE errors; allowedPayee (invoice destination) and allowedMarketplace (NWC caller) are separate policy fields seeded from HARBOR_COMMISSION_PAYEE_PUBKEY and HARBOR_MARKETPLACE_PUBKEY.
claims.expected: 'Unauthorized marketplace caller rejected', 'Unauthorized commission payee rejected', and 'Authorized marketplace + payee accepted' = pass.
claims.mutation_evidence: evidence/mutation-results.json — disabling the payee guard in the PRODUCTION source makes 'Unauthorized commission payee rejected' FAIL.
claims.limit: Policy-layer only. NWC request-path enforcement is separately proven by C12.

claims.claim: Commission budget is enforced atomically, including sequential reservations and the reserved routing-fee allowance.
claims.mechanism: PRODUCTION reserve() checks commissionMsat + routingFeeMsat <= remainingBudget on EVERY request (including the first), so the first reservation cannot exceed the budget by its own fee allowance. validateCommission() emits BUDGET_EXCEEDED. SQLite reserve() uses an immediate transaction for cross-process serialization.
claims.expected: budget exhaustion, sequential-reservation reduction, exact-fit acceptance, first-request fee-allowance rejection (5,000,000+26,000 rejected at 5,010,000; accepted at 5,026,000); summary 16/16.
claims.mutation_evidence: evidence/mutation-results.json — disabling the budget guard in the PRODUCTION source makes the first-request fee-allowance test FAIL.
claims.limit: In-process atomicity via synchronous BigInt accounting; single-process primary (multi-process SQLite tested in C11).

claims.claim: A replayed payment hash is rejected.
claims.mechanism: PRODUCTION reservation registry keyed by paymentHash; validateCommission() and reserve() emit DUPLICATE_HASH / refuse duplicate. Idempotency persists fingerprints so identical retries return the original result; changed parameters are rejected.
claims.mutation_evidence: evidence/mutation-results.json — disabling the duplicate-hash guard in the PRODUCTION source makes 'Duplicate hash rejected' FAIL.
claims.limit: Policy-layer only; reservation registry + idempotency keys.

claims.claim: Every production policy guard is load-bearing, not decorative.
claims.mechanism: Mutation harness disables one guard at a time in a throwaway COPY OF THE PRODUCTION commission-service.js, runs the conformance suite against the mutant, and requires the correlated test to fail; records production source SHA-256 before/after.
claims.expected: 4/4 guards load-bearing; byte_identical_restore = true; source_file = engine/bin/commission-service.js.
claims.limit: Mutates the production service module in an isolated temp directory; the working tree source is never modified and is proven byte-identical afterward.

claims.claim: The HARBOR exit/recovery pipeline passes its 34 offline checks.
claims.mechanism: run-pipeline.mjs: auditor → risk engine → exit planner → evidence recorder; force-close never auto-wins; hash-chain integrity.
claims.limit: Uses fixtures and a temp dir; no live node.

claims.claim: The channel-backup auditor passes its 10 offline checks against a mock LND.
claims.mechanism: auditor/test/run-offline.mjs: in-process mock REST on 127.0.0.1:19876; backup staleness by SHA-256.

claims.claim: Cancellation releases the reservation and leaves no funds moved or duplicate commission.
claims.mechanism: commission-flow-simulator.js drives the full state machine in SIM mode and asserts 5 cancellation invariants.
claims.expected: 'FLOW COMPLETE'; all 5 cancellation invariants hold; exit 0.
claims.limit: SIM mode with in-memory state; no real sats move. Restart recovery from real node state is covered by reconcile() (C15).

claims.claim: No credential material (private keys, macaroons, seeds) exists in reachable git history.
claims.mechanism: Dump all unique blobs reachable from git refs and scan for PEM keys, >=200-char hex secrets, and macaroon-format content; .gitignore blocks credential file types.
claims.limit: docker-compose.yml contains bitcoin:bitcoin, the public regtest dev default with no real value. Scan covers committed history only, not untracked local files.

claims.claim: Atomic budget reservation cannot be over-committed by concurrently arriving requests (single process and across SQLite processes).
claims.mechanism: Production CommissionPolicy.reserve() (not a separate ledger) performs check-then-commit synchronously: 8 interleaved async arrivals against a budget that fits three yield exactly 3 approvals, no over-commit, no double reserve. SQLite path wraps budget check + duplicate check + insert in one immediate transaction so separate processes cannot both approve against a stale balance.
claims.expected: 8/8 pass; 'ATOMIC BUDGET RESERVATION: VERIFIED (production implementation)'; first-request fee-allowance rejection; multi-process SQLite (skipped when better-sqlite3 unavailable).
claims.limit: Single-process Node is the primary proof; multi-process SQLite atomicity is exercised when better-sqlite3 is installed. Distributed/multi-root atomicity is NOT built or claimed.

claims.claim: NWC request paths cannot execute commission operations without an approved, verified caller; no caller-supplied pubkey is trusted.
claims.mechanism: Genuine NIP-47 transport (engine/bin/nwc-transport.js): kind:23194 signed requests verified with BIP-340/Schnorr (verifyEvent), decrypted with NIP-44 v2, p-tag addressed to the wallet, timestamp tolerance, request-event deduplication. Marketplace identity comes from the verified event author — never from request params. Strict method allowlist (get_info, lookup_invoice, make_commission_invoice); pay_invoice blocked. Connection approval/expiry/revocation. Plain HTTP adapter is loopback-only with a demo token and does not expose make_commission_invoice.
claims.expected: 13/13 pass; invalid signature, unapproved author, wrong p-tag, and caller-supplied-identity bypass all rejected; signed get_info/make_commission_invoice routed to production handler; connection approve/revoke works.
claims.limit: Relay subscription/publication integrated; a public relay is used for the live demo. No NWC connection lifetime UI beyond revocation in seller controls.

claims.claim: An independent verifier confirms the full Alice/Bob/Carol settlement against live LND node state, including the vendor's outgoing commission payment.
claims.mechanism: engine/bin/verifier.js queries all three nodes with read-only macaroons. Checks sale invoice (Alice), commission invoice (Bob), buyer payment (Carol), AND Alice's outgoing commission payment (ListPayments, paginated): terminal SUCCEEDED, exact hash, exact amount, valid preimage, SHA256(preimage)==payment hash, actual fee within policy cap, seller net reconciliation. Preimage checked in memory and redacted; never written.
claims.command: node engine/bin/verifier.js > evidence/bundle.json (requires 3 live nodes, credentials, ALIBI_PAYMENT_HASH)
claims.expected: summary {passed: 25, failed: 0}, exit 0, network=regtest, preimage_matches_hash=true, checksum present.
claims.regeneration: The verified settlement was driven through the PRODUCTION service by engine/bin/production-flow.js (see evidence/production-flow.json, payment_hash e01084644d8efb9975fe36f6948ed893a5d2cac2fb38114bea8dbe84d22ffa84): Bob's 5,000-sat commission hold invoice, the production handler's 100,000-sat sale hold invoice (CLTV 328), Carol's held HTLC, the production payCommission() with preflight + in-policy fee, Bob's preimage reveal, settleSale() gated on verified outgoing node state. The verifier then queried all three nodes with read-only macaroons, including Alice's outgoing commission payment.
claims.limit: Controlled regtest cycle. Node-state verification, not a Bitcoin consensus proof or trustless attestation. The verifier holds read-only credentials and never receives the preimage.

claims.claim: The production CommissionService completes the whole commission transaction and refuses to release the buyer's held payment until the outgoing commission payment is independently verified on the vendor node.
claims.mechanism: engine/bin/production-flow.js drives the real CommissionService (not a duplicated policy class) against live regtest LND REST with durable SQLite: hold invoices (sale CLTV 328), held buyer HTLC, NEGATIVE premature-settle refusal (even with correct preimage), payCommission() with preflight-before-send (decode, hash, amount, payee, network, expiry, CLTV) + post-send verification (SUCCEEDED, exact hash/amount/preimage/fee), Bob's preimage reveal, settleSale() re-querying ListPayments node state before settling, idempotent re-settle, final three-node state checks.
claims.command: see REPRODUCE.md §7 — production-flow.js with live regtest credentials
claims.expected: summary {passed: 17, failed: 0}; 'settlement_refused_before_outgoing_payment' = pass; 'sale_settled_only_after_outgoing_verification' = pass; payment_hash matches evidence/bundle.json.
claims.limit: Durable SQLite storage is now required in REAL mode (fail closed if unavailable). Live regtest only; no mainnet. Restart recovery across process crashes is exercised by reconcile() (C15) but a full kill/restart cycle is a recommended next step.

claims.claim: SQLite durable storage is used in REAL mode and fails closed if unavailable.
claims.mechanism: engine/bin/commission-service.js opens SQLite (better-sqlite3, WAL mode) with forward migrations. In REAL mode (LND credentials present), the service throws if durable storage cannot be opened — it never silently falls back to ephemeral in-memory state. SIM mode explicitly uses in-memory state and is labeled as such. Sale/commission/payment/reservation/audit state is persisted; budget is debited exactly once (commission + actual routing fee).
claims.command: node engine/bin/production-flow.js (REAL mode persists to data/alibi.sqlite; verify with a SQLite reader)
claims.expected: production-flow 17/17 with mode=REAL; SQLite rows for sales/commissions/reservations/budget persist after the process exits.
claims.limit: better-sqlite3 must be installed in the build environment; without it, REAL mode refuses to start (fail closed). Full kill/restart recovery timing is a recommended next step (reconcile() path exists in C13).

claims.claim: reconcile() repairs database drift from LND's authoritative node state idempotently after restart.
claims.mechanism: engine/bin/commission-service.js reconcile() queries LND (lookupInvoice + ListPayments) as the source of truth and repairs app-DB drift: marks settled/paid/canceled from node state, releases reservations on expired/canceled invoices. Idempotent (safe to re-run).
claims.command: node engine/bin/production-flow.js (includes idempotent re-settle stage); node engine/bin/commission-service.js reconcile <hash>
claims.expected: reconcile() returns safeToSettle only when both legs are final; re-settle after settlement is idempotent (no double debit).
claims.limit: The production-flow harness exercises an idempotent re-settle, not a full kill/restart of the Node process. A deliberate crash/restart recovery test is recommended future work.
